voice_direction: Brian [soft] frame, Frank clone [whispering] suggestion; speed ~0.85; let ellipses breathe

segments.text: This program is hypnotic in nature, and is never to be experienced in a moving vehicle, or other times when you need to maintain awakened consciousness.

For if so many of your finest ideas... remain waiting in the stone... works you were born to make, yet never quite begun... while others seem to carve, so boldly... as if their hands already knew the way...
...then this is your time to sit, or lie back, more comfortably relaxed.
Perhaps reassured by the memory of a certain studio in old Paris... where a master named Rodin spent his days... among figures half-emerged from marble... each one waiting... for its final strokes...
And you might even imagine... stepping through that tall studio door, as dusk settles over the city... into a room of white dust and quiet... where stone seems to breathe...
Dust like first snow upon the floor... chisels laid out in patient rows... a figure's hand emerging from its block... frozen mid-gesture... for a hundred years...
For the master never doubted the figure was already in the stone... he simply removed... what kept it hidden...
And you might even feel that same quiet certainty... settling over you now... like the stillness of the studio...
And as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you may notice the dust motes drifting... golden... in the last light of the tall windows...
Somewhere, the sound of a single chisel... slowing... slowing...
Golden dust of the studio... falling right upon you... falling right within you... enlightening you... deeply inside...
For as your body naturally breathes more deeply... you can enjoy not having to do anything at all... your inner, wiser self... wandering freely... through the studio... of your own becoming...
Deeper with every breath... as if sinking into the stone itself... to find the figure waiting there...
And here... inside your own quiet studio... all your unfinished works... stand waiting... in the half-light...
Ideas from every dream... every plan... every whisper of what if... each one resting... in the stone...
And the golden dust... drifting... settling...
For marble does not hurry... and neither must you... the figure has waited... a hundred years... gladly...
A talent long doubted... reveals itself... as a figure already formed...
A small beginning... to a finished work...
A single stroke today... to the masterpiece of years...
You may not notice... each stroke landing... until the day... the form looks back... at you...
For the figure was always in the stone... your work... is only to release it...
Perhaps the stone has always known your name... perhaps it has been waiting... to be touched... by you...
And you might be pleasantly surprised... how sure your hands have become... when you stop doubting... and simply let them carve...
Like the master... you need only make today's stroke... and trust the form within...
And the works you were born to make... are already within you... waiting only for your hands...
Each morning... a fresh block of marble... each evening... one stroke less... between you and the figure...
And the white dust on your hands... is not failure... it is proof... you have been carving...
You need not see the whole staircase... only today's stroke...
For courage is not the absence of doubt... it is the chisel... moving anyway...
And every finished work whispers to the next... you can be begun... you can be completed...
The studio of your mind... grows brighter... with every work you release...
For you have always been the sculptor... and the stone... has always been yours...
Your confidence... not something you must find... but something you uncover... stroke by stroke...
For like pigment waking in warm oil... your certainty deepens... the more gently... it is worked...
Each idea you begin... begins to breathe...
Each work you finish... teaches your hands... they can be trusted...
And soon... works completing... all around you... like figures stepping... from the stone...
You might look up one evening... and find the studio fuller... than you remember... figures everywhere...
For hesitation was only dust upon the marble... and it brushes away... so easily...
Your mind... one vast and luminous studio... every tool within reach... every work within sight...
For every tool you need... was hung within reach... long before... you thought to ask...
For the world is waiting... for the works only you can carve...
And your hands... were born... to make them...
And now... as the studio gently brightens... you can bring something back with you...
For what once seemed like fear... was only marble yet uncarved... and the figure within you... was never afraid...
And each idea that visits you, from this day forward... finds hands ready... to give it form...
And when an idea arrives... you begin.
When doubt appears... you carve through it.
When a work asks to be finished... you finish it.
For you are... the sculptor of your own life...
And the world... is waiting... for your work.
